```plato
//==
// # Numeric structures
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Component-wise algebra for the IVector interface
//  - Numeric structures components — the IVector component surface
//  - Derived functions for point-like types
//  - Derived functions for the IMatrix interface
//  - Derived functions for the IQuantity interface
//  - Geometric helpers for the IVector interface

library NumericStructures
{
    //==
    // # Component-wise algebra for the IVector interface
    //
    // The IAdditive / IArithmetic / IScalable / ILattice / IInterpolatable surface and
    // the per-component lifts of the Number intrinsics, all written once against the
    // component combinators below — written once against the IVector interface
    // rather than once per concrete type.

    //==
    // # IVector — component-wise algebra
    //
    // The IAdditive / IArithmetic / IScalable / ILattice / IInterpolatable surface,
    // all component-wise. Concrete types whose backend has a native vector
    // instruction (Number2/3/4/8 in `intrinsics.library.plato`) override these.

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x + y);
```
